description: Typed contracts for set-and-configuration.md; statuses and dependency dispositions follow CONTRIBUTING.md and proposals/README.md.

semantic_fields.reason: Membership is the whole defining datum of a Set over its declared local domain; which actual Presences realize a supplied predicate and carrier remains the application question recorded at SC-G1.

organon:Presence.reason: The supplied carrier stands for a declared local domain of member Presences and each Set value stands for the Presence those members fix; no global carrier or membership classifier is constructed.

organon:Absence.reason: The empty Set is an inhabited Set value, a Presence with no member; the exclusion of Absence is a prose boundary and no Absence symbol is imported.

organon:Relation.reason: The contrast with ordered association stays in prose: membership imposes no order on members, while the theorem neither asserts nor denies that membership can be modeled as a Relation.

organon:Reality.reason: The theorem quantifies over every supplied local carrier and builds no carrier of all Presence; it neither asserts nor refutes that Reality is a set, and licenses no local Set as exhaustive of Reality.

organon:Presence.reason: Carrier values stand for the Presences, including any Relations, that a supplied interpretation places in the local domain; no canonical carrier is constructed.

organon:Relation.reason: Relations enter only as possible carrier values; the general theorem imposes no Relation classifier, no requirement that a Relation be a member, and no participant closure. SC-C1 exercises a relation-like witness.

SC-D2.reason: A relation-like token carries designated witness participants; this exercises the absence of endpoint closure on a finite carrier, not a canonical Relation classifier or empirical Configuration.

formal_contract.reason: Applications must justify their declared domain, membership assignments, Relation tokens and identity criteria. Configuration is extensionally a Set; whether its retained role name and identifier should be consolidated under the collapse rule remains an explicit review question that the formal reduction does not decide.
